fieldValues.title: A quarter to a third of three corpora cannot be reached from the root
fieldValues.summary: Records outside any section a reader can reach exist only for search.
evidence: Audit 2026-10-30 S5: programme 73% (1346/1855) (6 of 87 containers unreachable), muSrs 67% (769/1143) (64 of 84 containers unreachable), spec 75% (534/711) (10 of 20 containers unreachable)
fieldValues.body: Place each unreached record in the section it belongs to or retire it; the muSrs restructure addresses most of muSrs. A coverage report in the engine (srs-rust#1490) would make this a standing check.
